Heading: Objectives
Text: Operational readiness is often discussed as if it were a unitary and readily measurable attribute. This evidence-informed integrative synthesis instead examines the boundaries of selected evidence across tactical, military, fire-service, and public-safety settings.

Heading: Methods
Text: We used the project fixed evidence universe, result-located extraction packets, design-matched appraisal, an external integrity recheck, and recorded human role decisions to construct a working full manuscript.

Heading: Results
Text: The active evidence supports bounded statements about sleep-loss mitigation, cardiometabolic surveillance, task-specific performance null findings, measurement properties, injury-risk associations, implementation constraints, and feasibility.

Heading: Conclusions
Text: It does not validate a global readiness score, establish universal occupational thresholds, or support causal claims from observational or feasibility designs. The resulting framework is a proposed synthesis framework and has not been validated. This final scientific freeze records the newly approved expansion claims as Claim-Ready YES after named human adjudication; that status does not substitute for future editorial or implementation review.
